The '''skirmish on Endymion''' was a conflict which took place in the remote desert [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endymion]] during a war of galactic proportions. It pit a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] against a [[Sith Warlord]].
